_note: Placeholder dart types until Paul's blaster cards exist. Units: metres, seconds. drag is the fraction of speed lost per second (v *= 1 - drag * dt). gravityScale multiplies 9.81 m/s^2. impulse is in newton-seconds and is applied to a dynamic body when a dart hits it, capped so the body's speed changes by at most maxPushSpeed (m/s). Darts are drawn larger than real foam darts on purpose, so they read on screen. fireInterval is the minimum seconds between shots of this type. carveRadius is the radius in metres a dart of this type can carve from a voxel volume on impact.

mega._note: GAME-09d: the mega dart (B06, and B07's launcher round later, D14). 1.6 times the standard radius, a little slower, more drop, more impulse, a bigger carve. Start values for Paul to tune on the range.

launcher._note: GAME-09f: B07's launcher round (D14, Paul: five ammo types: a mega dart with a foam warhead). Slow (18 m/s) with much more drop than a mega dart, so it comes in on a high arc; big and heavy, so a lot of impulse. It explodes at its first hit, every shot (the blaster tags every shot). Start values for Paul to tune on the range.

precision._note: GAME-09e: the precision dart, B05's whistler (design/blasters/B05.md): fast, flat, thin, a small carve, high damage (the damage table in data/foamers.json). pierce: how many Foamers it flies through before it stops (a wall or the floor always stops it). The heavier-rounds mod reads pierce 3 there. Start values for Paul to tune on the range.

precisionHeavy._note: GAME-09e mod 2 (Paul): B05's heavier round: the same thin dart, a little slower, more impulse, and it pierces three Foamers. Its damage is data/foamers.json's precisionHeavy. Start values for Paul to tune.
